topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: When I heard the building was transitioning to condos, I supposed it was inevitable. The landlord's intentions have always been clearer than the water in a stagnant pond. Change, after all, is a constant, even in a structure as solid as this. I took a slow walk around the building, hands in pockets, observing the familiar sights—the old oak by the entrance, the chipped paint on the third-floor railing. I felt no urgency, no rush to react. The news settled around me like the quiet after a storm, and I began to consider the next steps with a methodical, unhurried pace.
